newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks down in meagre trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks down in meagre trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly down on meagre trading on Tuesday with losses among some of the blue chip shares.
* Of five active issues four fell and one was up.
* Volume was up at 2,806 shares and so was turnover at 0.7 million kuna.
* Biggest loser was confectioner Kras, which plunged 160 kuna to close at 490 on a meagre volume of 100 shares.
* Among losers was also fully listed Zagrebacka Banka, edging down 50 kuna to close at 980, on volume of 271, following a donward trend in London.
* The only gainer was hotelier Suncani Hvar, which inched up 3 kuna to close at 60 on volume of 1,084.
* Most actively traded issue was food processor Podravka, which lost 9 kuna to close at 250 on volume of 1,280. ($1 = 5.4359 kuna) -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4551-840
